finishedTip: Keep expanding, decorating, and making it yours

outsidePlot: Build within the plot, between layers 0 and 11

placeBike: Place a generator bicycle to pedal

circuitOff: Circuit off or no energy available

adviceBattery: Add a battery to store surplus daytime energy
adviceNight: It’s nighttime: panels produce no power, so the home uses its battery or the grid
adviceDay: Panels produce more around noon and charge the battery with any surplus
graphicsDescription: Match rendering resolution to your device
dayCycleDescription: Cycle naturally between day and night
dayLengthDescription: Real time for one complete game day
installDescription: On desktop or Android, use “Install app” in the browser menu — on iPhone or iPad, open in Safari and choose Share → Add to Home Screen — the game is available offline after the first complete load
pauseBody: Take a breath — your build will be here
worldsIntro: Small beginnings, big builds — your creations are saved on this device
noWorlds: Your first project begins with a brick
invalidWorld: This file is not a valid Chimpi world
inventoryNote: Choose a material and click the plot or a block face — R rotates the object before placement
stepsIntro: Eight small steps for your first great build
stepsAbstraction: Steps inspired by your video and adapted to blocks — these are simplified game rules
helpWalk: Use the keys or virtual joystick to move your character around the plot
helpRotate: Drag the scene to orbit, and use the mouse wheel or + / − to zoom
helpPlace: In build view, click the ground or a block face to place the selected block
helpRemove: Remove the targeted block — you can also select the pickaxe tool
helpInventory: Number keys select toolbar materials; E opens all materials
helpMore: F switches cameras, R rotates blocks, and Space jumps — in first person, click to capture the mouse, left click removes, and right click builds — G opens or closes the targeted door
touchHelp: On mobile: drag to look, use the left joystick to walk, and tap the hammer, pickaxe, or arrow to build, remove, or jump — tapping the plot in build view also places blocks
desc_0: A firm foundation gives the home its shape — place concrete blocks in the plot or build the whole step at once
tip_0: Tip: click the ground to place blocks and drag the scene to look from another angle
desc_1: Add a waterproofing layer around the foundation before raising the walls
tip_1: In the video, waterproofing helps keep moisture from rising up the walls
desc_2: Columns at the four corners define your home’s structure and wall height
tip_2: Use the layer arrows to place blocks higher above the plot
desc_3: Fill the sides with bricks, leaving space for the door and windows
tip_3: Use the pickaxe to remove any block you want to change
desc_4: Place doors, windows, and beams over the openings to complete the structure
tip_4: The lintels in the video become beams above openings here
desc_5: Cover your home with a layered roof, inspired by the slope in the video
tip_5: Rotate or zoom the view with the controls on the right
desc_6: Add flooring, plants, and the first furniture — the rest of the decoration is up to you
tip_6: Open Materials to choose new colors, furniture, and plants
desc_7: Install solar panels, a battery, and a simple circuit to light your home and power its TV
tip_7: Next, open Energy and switch on the breaker — at night the battery stores the day’s sunshine
pointAtDoor: Point at a door to open or close it
